name: ALLY 26 – Kampagnen
description: Unterablauf der neuen Oberfläche (BA6, Migration 61): Kampagnen – Liste, Kampagne mit Überblick, Briefing, Talents und Deliverables, Zeitplan, Erinnerungen, Freigaben, Reporting; Beiträge zuordnen. Liefert nur JSON (Seitenbeschreibung).

parameters.query:
WITH s AS (SELECT x.person FROM ally_ui_sitzung($1::text) x WHERE NOT x.muss_pw_setzen),
z AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(z.schluessel, z.wert), '{}'::jsonb) AS z FROM ally_ui_zustand z JOIN s ON z.person = s.person
      WHERE z.schluessel IN ('kampagnen.alle', 'kampagnen.deliverables'))
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s) = 1 AS ok, $2::text AS ansicht,
  CASE WHEN $2::text = 'liste' THEN talents_kampagnen_ui($1::text, $4::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('sortierung', (SELECT z.z->'kampagnen.alle'->'sortierung' FROM z))) END AS l,
  CASE WHEN $2::text IN ('kampagne', 'zuordnen') THEN talents_kampagne_ui($1::text, nullif($3::text, '')::integer,
    CASE WHEN $2::text = 'kampagne' THEN $4::jsonb ELSE '{}'::jsonb END || jsonb_build_object('sortierung', (SELECT z.z->'kampagnen.deliverables'->'sortierung' FROM z))) END AS k,
  CASE WHEN $2::text = 'zuordnen' THEN talents_ui_kampagne_zuordnen($1::text, nullif($3::text, '')::integer, $4::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('seite', $5::text)) END AS z1,
  CASE WHEN $2::text = 'zuordnen' THEN talents_ui_kampagne_zuordnen($1::text, nullif($3::text, '')::integer, $4::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('seite', $6::text)) END AS z2;
